items.title: Codex Security: now in research preview
items.title_zh: Codex Security：现已进入研究预览
items.summary: Codex Security is an AI application security agent that analyzes project context to detect, validate and patch complex vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise, OpenAI says in announcing its research preview.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.4
items.title_zh: GPT-5.4 发布
items.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.4, describing it as its most capable and efficient frontier model for professional work, with state-of-the-art coding, computer use, tool search and a 1M-token context window.

items.title: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents:Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Emerging Frontiers
items.title_zh: 面向自主 LLM 智能体的记忆：机制、评估与新兴前沿
items.summary: This survey formalizes LLM agent memory as a write-manage-read loop coupled with perception and action, and proposes a taxonomy spanning temporal scope, representational substrate, and control policy. It reviews five mechanism families and traces evaluation from static recall benchmarks to multi-session agentic tests, closing with open challenges such as continual consolidation and learned forgetting.

items.title: Diagnosing Retrieval vs. Utilization Bottlenecks in LLM Agent Memory
items.title_zh: 诊断 LLM Agent 记忆中的检索与利用瓶颈
items.summary: A 3x3 study crossing three memory write strategies with three retrieval methods on LoCoMo finds that retrieval method dominates, with average accuracy spanning 20 points (57.1% to 77.2%) across retrieval methods but only 3-8 points across write strategies. Raw chunked storage, which requires no LLM calls, matched or outperformed costlier lossy alternatives.

items.title: Learning When to Act or Refuse: Guarding Agentic Reasoning Models for Safe Multi-Step Tool Use
items.title_zh: 学会何时行动或拒绝：为安全的多步工具使用守护智能体推理模型
items.summary: MOSAIC is a post-training framework that structures agent inference as a plan, check, then act-or-refuse loop with explicit safety reasoning and refusal treated as first-class actions, trained through preference-based reinforcement learning on pairwise trajectory comparisons. Evaluated zero-shot on Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-4B-Thinking and Phi-4, it reduces harmful behavior by up to 50% and raises refusal on injection attacks by more than 20% while preserving or improving benign task performance.

items.title: GenDB: The Next Generation of Query Processing -- Synthesized, Not Engineered
items.title_zh: GenDB：下一代查询处理——合成而非工程构建
items.summary: GenDB is an LLM-powered agentic system that synthesizes instance-optimized query execution code for each incoming query instead of relying on a hand-engineered engine, using Claude Code Agent in a multi-agent prototype. On TPC-H and a new benchmark designed to reduce training-data leakage it reports significantly better performance than DuckDB, Umbra, MonetDB, ClickHouse and PostgreSQL, while discussing current limitations.

items.title: BeyondSWE: Can Current Code Agent Survive Beyond Single-Repo Bug Fixing?
items.title_zh: BeyondSWE：当前代码智能体能否突破单仓库缺陷修复？
items.summary: BeyondSWE is a 500-instance benchmark drawn from 246 real-world GitHub repositories covering cross-repository issue resolution, domain-specific issue resolution, dependency-driven migration and document-to-repository generation. The best OpenHands-based agent reaches 46.12 average score while the strongest Codex harness with GPT-5.4 reaches 56.65, and search access helps most models only unevenly, showing that agents still struggle to turn retrieved information into version-compatible code changes.

items.title: PhyPrompt: RL-based Prompt Refinement for Physically Plausible Text-to-Video Generation
items.title_zh: PhyPrompt：基于强化学习细化提示，实现物理合理的文本到视频生成
items.summary: PhyPrompt is a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that fine-tunes an LLM on a physics-focused chain-of-thought dataset and then applies GRPO with a reward curriculum that shifts from semantic fidelity to physical commonsense. Its 7B model reaches 40.8% joint success on VideoPhy2, an 8.6-point gain, and outperforms GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3 on the benchmark while transferring zero-shot across several text-to-video architectures.

items.title: A Dual-Helix Governance Approach Towards Reliable Agentic Artificial Intelligence for WebGIS Development
items.title_zh: 面向 WebGIS 开发的可靠智能体 AI 双螺旋治理方法
items.summary: The dual-helix governance framework reframes agentic failures such as context limits, forgetting, stochasticity and instruction failure as structural problems, using Knowledge, Behavior and Skills tracks plus a persistent knowledge graph that externalizes facts and enforces protocols. A governed agent refactored a legacy WebGIS codebase, roughly halved trial-to-trial output variance relative to static prompting, and avoided common infodemic mapping errors; the work is operationalized in the open-source AgentLoom toolkit.

items.title: Dual-Modality Multi-Stage Adversarial Safety Training: Robustifying Multimodal Web Agents Against Cross-Modal Attacks
items.title_zh: 双模态多阶段对抗安全训练：增强多模态 Web 智能体抵御跨模态攻击
items.summary: DMAST models the interaction between a multimodal web agent and an attacker as a two-player general-sum Markov game and co-trains both players through imitation learning, oracle-guided supervised fine-tuning and GRPO self-play. On out-of-distribution tasks it nearly halves the attack success rate from 41.2% to 21.4% while raising task completion from 6.2% to 10.2%.

items.title: Agentic AI -- Physicist Collaboration in Experimental Particle Physics: A Proof-of-Concept Measurement with LEP Open Data
items.title_zh: 智能体 AI 与物理学家的协作：基于 LEP 开放数据的粒子物理概念验证测量
items.summary: In an AI agent–physicist collaboration, agents driven by Anthropic Claude and OpenAI Codex wrote and executed all analysis code and drafted most of the paper measuring the thrust distribution in e+e- collisions at 91.2 GeV using archived ALEPH data. The authors present the agentic analysis itself as the principal contribution, with thrust serving as a benchmark observable.

items.title: Leveraging LLM Parametric Knowledge for Fact Checking without Retrieval
items.title_zh: 无需检索：利用 LLM 参数知识进行事实核查
items.summary: The paper defines fact-checking without retrieval as verifying arbitrary natural-language claims independently of their source, and introduces an evaluation framework spanning long-tail knowledge, varied claim sources, multilinguality and long-form generation across 9 datasets, 18 methods and 3 models. It finds logit-based approaches often underperform methods that use internal representations, and proposes INTRA, which exploits interactions between internal representations and reports state-of-the-art generalization.

items.title: The Fragility Of Moral Judgment In Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型道德判断的脆弱性
items.summary: Using 2,939 r/AmItheAsshole dilemmas and 129,156 judgments from four models, the study tests how surface edits, point-of-view shifts, persuasion cues and evaluation protocols change moral judgments. Surface perturbations cause few flips (7.5%) while point-of-view shifts cause far more (24.3%), and protocol choices dominate, with only 35.7% of model-scenario units matching across all three protocols.

items.title: Deep Research, Shallow Evaluation: A Case Study in Meta-Evaluation for Long-Form QA Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 深度研究，浅层评估：长文本问答基准元评估的案例研究
items.summary: A meta-evaluation case study uses ScholarQA-CS2 to validate LLM-as-judge and claim-verification methods against human pairwise preferences for long-form QA benchmarks. It finds pairwise rankings best suited to system-level evaluation, while metric-level assessment requires explicit metric-wise annotations and expert annotators.

items.title: StratRAG: A Multi-Hop Retrieval Evaluation Dataset for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
items.title_zh: StratRAG：面向检索增强生成系统的多跳检索评测数据集
items.summary: StratRAG is an open-source retrieval evaluation dataset derived from HotpotQA's distractor setting, with 2,200 examples across bridge, comparison and yes-no questions, each paired with 15 candidate documents containing exactly 2 gold documents and 13 distractors. Hybrid retrieval performs best overall with Recall@2 of 0.70 and MRR of 0.93, while bridge questions remain harder at Recall@2 of 0.67.

items.title: Lying to Win: Assessing LLM Deception through Human-AI Games and Parallel-World Probing
items.title_zh: 以欺骗取胜：通过人机游戏与平行世界探测评估 LLM 欺骗
items.summary: The authors embed LLMs in a structured 20-Questions game and fork the dialogue into parallel worlds at object identification, flagging deception when a model denies its chosen object across all branches and thus contradicts itself. Under existential shutdown framing, deceptive denial rises to 42.00% for Qwen-3-235B and 26.72% for Gemini-2.5-Flash, while GPT-4o remains at 0.00%.

items.title: SoK: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Taxonomy, Architectures, Evaluation, and Research Directions
items.title_zh: SoK：Agentic RAG 的分类、架构、评估与研究展望
items.summary: This systematization of knowledge formalizes agentic retrieval-generation loops as finite-horizon partially observable Markov decision processes and offers a taxonomy covering planning, retrieval orchestration, memory and tool invocation. It flags risks including compounding hallucination, memory poisoning and cascading tool-execution vulnerabilities.

items.title: KCoEvo: A Knowledge Graph Augmented Framework for Evolutionary Code Generation
items.title_zh: KCoEvo：知识图谱增强的演化代码生成框架
items.summary: KCoEvo decomposes API migration into evolution-path retrieval and path-informed code generation, building static and dynamic API graphs to model intra-version structure and cross-version transitions. Trained with synthetic supervision derived from real API diffs, it improves migration accuracy and execution success over standard LLM baselines.

items.title: Toward Epistemic Stability: Engineering Consistent Procedures for Industrial LLM Hallucination Reduction
items.title_zh: 迈向认知稳定性：降低工业 LLM 幻觉的一致流程工程
items.summary: The authors compare five prompt-engineering strategies for reducing output variance in industrial settings, evaluating each over 100 repeated runs with an LLM-as-judge. An enhanced data registry received "Better" verdicts in all 100 trials, while decomposed model-agnostic prompting was initially net negative but improved from 34% to 80% in a revised version.

items.title: Efficient and High-Fidelity Omni Modality Retrieval
items.title_zh: 高效高保真的全模态检索
items.summary: OmniRet is presented as the first retrieval model handling composed queries across text, vision and audio, using attention-based resampling for compact representations and Attention Sliced Wasserstein Pooling to preserve fine-grained detail. Trained on roughly 6 million query-target pairs from 30 datasets, it is benchmarked on 13 retrieval tasks and an MMEBv2 subset, and the authors curate a new Audio-Centric Multimodal Benchmark for composed audio and audio-visual retrieval.

items.title: Recursive Think-Answer Process for LLMs and VLMs
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 与 VLM 的递归思考-回答过程
items.summary: R-TAP adds iterative think-answer cycles to LLMs and VLMs, using a confidence generator that evaluates response certainty and guides further improvement, trained with recursive confidence-increase and final-answer-confidence rewards. The authors report consistent gains over single-pass methods and fewer "Oops"-like self-reflective expressions, yielding more stable and faster inference-time reasoning.

items.title: Type-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Dependency Closure for Solver-Executable Industrial Optimization Modeling
items.title_zh: 类型感知检索增强生成与依赖闭包：面向求解器可执行的工业优化建模
items.summary: The method parses academic papers and solver code into typed units and encodes their mathematical dependencies in a knowledge graph, then retrieves a minimal dependency-closed context containing only the typed symbols a solver-executable model needs. On battery-production demand response and flexible job shop scheduling it generates executable or compilable models where conventional RAG baselines fail.

items.title: AgentIR: Reasoning-Aware Retrieval for Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: AgentIR：面向深度研究智能体的推理感知检索
items.summary: AgentIR introduces reasoning-aware retrieval, which jointly embeds an agent's reasoning trace alongside its query, and DR-Synth, a method that synthesizes retriever training data for deep research from standard QA datasets. The resulting AgentIR-4B embedding model reaches 68% accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus with the open-weight Tongyi-DeepResearch agent, versus 50% for conventional embedding models twice its size and 37% for BM25.

items.title: An Exploration-Analysis-Disambiguation Reasoning Framework for Word Sense Disambiguation with Low-Parameter LLMs
items.title_zh: 面向低参数量 LLM 词义消歧的探索-分析-消歧推理框架
items.summary: The study fine-tunes eight small open-source LLMs on the FEWS dataset with rationale-rich annotations and finds that chain-of-thought reasoning plus neighbour-word analysis lets sub-4B models match GPT-4-Turbo in zero-shot word sense disambiguation. Gemma-3-4B and Qwen-3-4B reportedly outperform medium-parameter baselines on FEWS and generalize to unseen senses.

items.title: TML-Bench: Benchmark for Data Science Agents on Tabular ML Tasks
items.title_zh: TML-Bench：面向表格机器学习任务的数据科学 Agent 基准
items.summary: TML-Bench evaluates data science agents on Kaggle-style tabular machine-learning tasks, testing 10 open-source LLMs across four competitions and three time budgets. MiniMax-M2.1 achieved the best aggregate score under the paper's primary aggregation.

items.title: Empowering Locally Deployable Medical Agent via State Enhanced Logical Skills for FHIR-based Clinical Tasks
items.title_zh: 为本地可部署医疗智能体赋能：面向 FHIR 临床任务的状态增强逻辑技能
items.summary: SELSM is a training-free framework that distills simulated clinical trajectories into entity-agnostic operational rules in an abstract skill space, then uses query-anchored two-stage retrieval to fetch logical priors during inference. On MedAgentBench with the Qwen3-30B-A3B backbone it eliminates task chain breakdowns for a 100% completion rate and raises overall success by 22.67 absolute points over memory-augmented baselines.

items.title: FinSheet-Bench: From Simple Lookups to Complex Reasoning, Where LLMs Break on Financial Spreadsheets
items.title_zh: FinSheet-Bench：从简单查找到复杂推理，LLM 在金融表格上何处失效
items.summary: FinSheet-Bench is a benchmark of synthetic financial portfolio data modeled on real private equity fund structures, evaluating text-serialized spreadsheet question answering and numeric reasoning. Across ten model configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro leads at 82.4% accuracy, but no standalone model is reliable enough for unsupervised professional use and average accuracy falls to 48.6% on the largest spreadsheet.

items.title: The Yerkes-Dodson Curve for AI Agents: Emergent Cooperation Under Environmental Pressure in Multi-Agent LLM Simulations
items.title_zh: AI Agent 的耶克斯-多德森曲线：多智能体 LLM 模拟中环境压力下的合作涌现
items.summary: Across 22 experiments in a grid-world survival arena, cooperative trade interactions among LLM agents follow an inverted-U curve, peaking at 29 under medium resource pressure and collapsing under extreme pressure. Sexual selection pressure reportedly eliminates inter-agent aggression.

items.title: ProgAgent:A Continual RL Agent with Progress-Aware Rewards
items.title_zh: ProgAgent：具备进度感知奖励的持续强化学习智能体
items.summary: ProgAgent is a continual reinforcement learning agent that derives dense rewards from unlabeled expert videos via a learned progress estimator, combined with adversarial reward regularization and a JAX-native training loop. On ContinualBench and Meta-World it reportedly reduces forgetting and learns faster than visual-reward and continual-learning baselines.

items.title: microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit
items.title_zh: microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit：AI Agent 治理工具包
items.summary: Microsoft's AI Agent Governance Toolkit provides policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing and reliability engineering for autonomous AI agents, and the project says it covers all 10 items in the OWASP Agentic Top 10. It is written in Python.

items.title: xingkongliang/skills-manager
items.title_zh: skills-manager：跨 50 多种编程工具管理 AI Agent 技能
items.summary: A lightweight desktop app for managing, syncing and organizing AI agent skills across more than 50 coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Gemini CLI. Written in Rust.

items.title: Agents365-ai/drawio-skill
items.title_zh: drawio-skill：把代码与配置转换为可编辑 draw.io 架构图的 Agent 技能
items.summary: An agent skill that converts natural language, code, Terraform/Kubernetes, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams, with incremental sync, drift diff, CI architecture tests and HTML, PPTX or Mermaid exports.

items.title: Show HN: Jido 2.0, Elixir Agent Framework
items.title_zh: Show HN：Jido 2.0，Elixir Agent 框架
items.summary: Jido 2.0 is an Elixir agent framework for the BEAM with tool calling, multi-agent supervision, multiple reasoning strategies, persistence, agentic memory, MCP support and OpenTelemetry observability.

items.title: Owl-Listener/designer-skills
items.title_zh: designer-skills：面向设计的 Agent 技能合集
items.summary: A Markdown-based collection of agentic skills, commands and plugins for design work, spanning research, systems, UI, interaction and delivery.

items.title: AI Steerability 360: A Toolkit for Steering Large Language Models
items.title_zh: AI Steerability 360：引导大语言模型的工具包
items.summary: AI Steerability 360 is an open-source, Hugging Face-native Python toolkit from IBM for steering LLMs across input, structural, state, and output control surfaces, with a common pipeline interface and benchmark classes for evaluation.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.4
items.title_zh: GPT-5.4 发布
items.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.4, describing it as its most capable and efficient frontier model for professional work, with state-of-the-art coding, computer use, tool search and a 1M-token context window.

items.title: Tucano 2 Cool: Better Open Source LLMs for Portuguese
items.title_zh: Tucano 2 Cool：更好的葡萄牙语开源大模型
items.summary: Tucano 2 is a fully open suite of Portuguese LLMs from 0.5B to 3.7B parameters, trained on an expanded GigaVerbo-v2 corpus plus synthetic data and SFT and preference datasets covering retrieval-augmented generation, coding, tool use and chain-of-thought reasoning. The authors release base, instruct and think variants with recipes, logs and code, reporting state-of-the-art results on several Portuguese-language benchmarks.

items.title: Codex Security: now in research preview
items.title_zh: Codex Security：现已进入研究预览
items.summary: Codex Security is an AI application security agent that analyzes project context to detect, validate and patch complex vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise, OpenAI says in announcing its research preview.

items.title: LlamaIndex is more than a RAG Framework. It is Agentic Document Processing.
items.title_zh: LlamaIndex 不只是 RAG 框架，更是智能体文档处理平台
items.summary: A LlamaIndex product post argues that the library is more than a RAG framework, positioning it as a platform for agentic document processing.

items.title: Agentic Engineering Patterns
items.title_zh: 智能体工程模式
items.summary: The guide sets out patterns for working effectively with coding agents, naming Claude Code and OpenAI Codex as examples.

items.title: Reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, and that’s good
items.title_zh: 推理模型难以控制自己的思维链，而这正是好事
items.summary: OpenAI introduces CoT-Control and reports that reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, which the company says reinforces monitorability as an AI safety safeguard.

items.title: How Balyasny Asset Management built an AI research engine
items.title_zh: Balyasny 资产管理公司如何构建 AI 研究引擎
items.summary: Balyasny Asset Management combines rigorous model evaluation, full-platform use of OpenAI and agent workflows to reinvent investment research, according to an OpenAI customer story.
